common.protocol: Both saved native actor RGB/alpha PNGs composed with the same extended plate; clamp to [0,1]. Identical masks per group. Exact-region PSNR; tight zero-masked SSIM/LPIPS.
common.limitation: Quantized training-view diagnostics; temporal plates and learned alpha are fallible. Does not validate physical opacity or unseen views.

regions.origin: Existing frozen DEC5 diagnostic polygons; evaluation only

regions.protocol: Quantized PNG; exact-region PSNR; tight zero-masked SSIM/LPIPS, padded to >=64px
regions.limitations: Interior diagnostics; do not validate silhouettes or temporal consistency

background.protocol: Seed 42; same base pixels, HD centers versus jittered native photo + bilinear observed plate; maximum channel residual
background.limitations: Different image footprints and noise. Existing empty/zero-alpha labels and temporal plates are fallible; no ground-truth alpha or new targets.

interval_audit.scope: Read-only exact-float training rays; no targets or model changes. Hypothetical contraction depends on F in [0,1] and a valid B +/- d interval. Empirical p90 errors are not certified intervals.
interval_audit.limitation: Alpha target is an estimate. No claim this explains the whole artifact. No contraction has been trained.

conditional_bound_sanity.protocol: Independent random feasible RGB blends, exact float64; conditional algebra check, not scene-validation

gradient_audit.derivative: Batch-size-scaled d objective / d log ray-weight gain; positive pushes opacity down
gradient_audit.protocol: Training sampler/native targets; torch/numpy/Python seed 73; deterministic ray integration; no Frequency Grid or model updates
gradient_audit.limitations:
Diagnose opacity-directed objective derivatives on unchanged training rays.

Scale each ray's weights and premultiplied color together while retaining its
conditional color/depth distribution. This isolates a local opacity direction;
it is not the gradient of any one network parameter or a causal artifact proof.

first_batch.protocol: Native photo and bilinear measured HD background at identical subpixel coordinates; opaque native patches unchanged
